models.note: Two wells 3.5 km apart put the body in two different REGIONS. With the respawn point emptied the body does not move at all — the direction that proves the position came from the TABLE and not from a constant. The 17 m offset from the basin is the province setting the capsule down on ground that will hold it, is present on the respawn frame itself (settle_50f_m is 0), and is reported rather than tuned away.
